clues: This town is the capital of its province in China. It sits on flat lake land, with hills to the west and a large lake to the east.
Summers here are long, wet, and among the hottest of any province capital in China. Spring is grey and rainy, while autumn stays warm and dry.
In 1927, a bold revolt here fired the first shot against the ruling side. That shot is still seen as the start of a new army.
This town ranks among the top one hundred towns in the world for new science work. Its labs and schools draw bright minds from far away.
Trains from all over south China meet and cross in this town. Its spot links the rich east and south, so rails run through it.
